assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: wide environmental backdrop for the Grand Library’s lesson archive in a retro fantasy educational game.
Scene: a side gallery of an existing sandstone Grand Library, after dusk. A richly carved dark-walnut bookcase curves around a tall arched window on the right, showing distant small floating sandstone islands and deep indigo twilight. Two amber lanterns and a few ivy leaves frame the shelves. Lots of tiny worn books with muted ochre, sage, and ink-blue spines, warm light spilling onto wood and sandstone. The center and especially the left behind the game heading are shadowy brown and quiet, and the lower third recedes into walnut shadow, because functioning books and a shelf will be layered there in the app.
Style: hand-clustered 2D RPG pixel art background, firm square pixel clusters and limited color ramps, painterly composition at low internal resolution, a warm amber against cool twilight contrast. Cozy, lived-in and slightly mysterious. Landscape 16:9, edge-to-edge composition. Focus the window and lantern glow in the upper-right third. Full bleed scenery only. No text, emblems, people, interface, frames, foreground furniture, or watermarks.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset: one tightly packed texture atlas of three richly illustrated antique book cover boards for a 2D high-end pixel art fantasy RPG library. A single LANDSCAPE 2:1 composition divided into three EXACTLY equal-width portrait panels touching edge to edge. Each third is one full-bleed upright flat rectangular cover, entirely front-facing, exactly the same height, no perspective, zero gutters or padding. Left: oxblood leather with a gilt arch around a brilliantly illuminated volcanic mountain, orange lava river and dark rock crystals, delicate copper engraved stars. Middle: deep forest green leather, a huge luminous ivory quill and curling folio pages amid moonlit vines, illuminated manuscript botanical border. Right: deep petrol-blue leather and golden celestial geometry, brass drafting compass with two pointed legs above a miniature stepped sandstone ruin, orbiting geometric stars, an engraved astrolabe halo. Upper two thirds of EACH cover filled with its distinctive elaborate emblematic scene. Lower quarter of EACH cover a quiet dark matching leather cartouche with plenty of clear space for live game lettering. Exquisite oversized brass corner ornaments, gilt blind tooling, visibly ridged binding along extreme left of each third, uneven worn highlights, thick stitched edges. Hand-placed square pixel clusters and deliberate limited 32-bit RPG sprite palette, high contrast, intricate craftsmanship visible at a small game scale. Three completely textless artworks: no letters, numbers, words, glyph-like scribbles, watermarks, shelves, mockup layout, or any outer margins.

Use case: illustration-story. Single game texture atlas for the spines of four locked antique library books, viewed straight on. Wide landscape 2:1 canvas, divided into FOUR horizontal book spines of exactly equal height stacked flush with each other. Each horizontal stripe is a complete, separate, perfectly rectangular long book spine, stretching edge to edge. Zero gaps, zero surroundings, no perspective. The top stripe is worn umber leather, second faded moss green, third dried plum, bottom deep slate teal. Cozy fantasy RPG pixel art, deliberate chunky square pixel clusters, low-key warm light, same craftsmanship as late-medieval gilt leather-bound illuminated manuscripts. Gilt raised bands near both ENDS, tiny embossed corner flourishes, interesting rubbed edges and aged glints, thick leather hinges. The entire middle two-thirds of EACH spine is plain dark leather with gentle texture, reserved for real text in game. Every spine feels individually hand bound. Restrained palette, very readable at only 280x40 pixels per spine, quiet worn antiques beside much more ornate illustrated books. NO text, no letters or numbers, no central emblem, no horizontal lines through the central text areas, no padlocks, no room or background.
